title: Glowing search icon pulls out to a panel, button flips in
summary: One dark shot: a red-haloed search icon pulls out to reveal it sits in a sidebar header with a red rim light, the panel dims away, then a glowing button turns from edge-on to face the camera.
use_when: A short teaser for one UI action (search, share, export) on a dark brand
Intro or social loop where a single icon and one button carry the story
Brands with a strong saturated accent that can be the light source
Silent autoplay where light and one camera move replace copy

look.type_style: UI grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking: panel labels ~4 % H at the settled framing; button label bold, ~9 % H at the end, white on a red-orange gradient

sfx.event: camera pulls out from the icon to the panel (1.25 s)
edge-on button sliver lights up (4.25 s)
button turns to face the camera and settles (5.50-6.50 s)

structure.shot: outline search glyph glowing white-pink in the centre of a large red radial halo on black
structure.camera: pull-out: glyph and halo shrink ~1.00 -> 0.70 over 38 fr while drifting right then down-left (motion.json zoom -27 %/s in s 0-1)
structure.motion: halo radius shrinks with the scale, easings.inOutSine ~38 fr (suggested, ±0.25 s); glyph keeps its glow, no entrance (present from f0)

structure.shot: the glyph turns out to be the search button of a dark sidebar panel: logo mark, workspace name with chevron, two tabs; red rim light hugs the panel's top-left corner
structure.camera: pull-out continues: panel ~1.6 -> 1.0 (label width 1.27 vs 1.77 cells), springs.cameraOut ~22 fr (overshoot not measurable)
structure.motion: the red halo hands over from the glyph to a rim glow behind the panel corner; panel fades up from near-black within ~8 fr (±0.25 s); glyph halo dims to a small red spot

structure.shot: panel hold: top-left corner of the panel, red rim glow along its top and left edges, rest of frame black
structure.camera: drift: slight push 1.00 -> ~1.02 and slow pan down ~5 px/fr @1920 (motion.json s 2-4)
structure.motion: rim glow breathes slightly; no element enters; easings.linear drift (suggested)

structure.shot: panel dims and slides down, the rim glow fades to a dull red band, frame falls almost to black
structure.motion: glow and panel opacity 1 -> ~0.3 by 4.00 s, gone by 4.27 s, easings.inQuad ~22 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a thin vertical glowing sliver (a button seen exactly edge-on) on black with a faint orange halo, wandering across centre
structure.camera: static frame; the object moves: centre-top at 4.27, centre 4.50, right of centre 4.77, left 5.00, centre 5.27
structure.motion: sliver light-on in ~8 fr (±0.25 s), lateral sway ~1/6 W each 0.25 s, easings.inOutSine (suggested; the sway reads as a slow wobble in Y rotation near 90 deg)

structure.shot: the sliver rotates in Y to reveal the face: a rounded red-orange gradient button with a one-word action label
structure.camera: static frame; object grows ~3x in width (65 -> 170 px of a 480 cell, 5.77 -> 6.50)
structure.motion: rotateY ~90 -> 0 deg plus slight Z tilt that straightens, springs.heavy ~30 fr (overshoot not measurable); lands front-on at ~6.50

structure.shot: front-on action button with bold one-word label, soft orange halo on black
structure.camera: drift: button sways left (7.00) and back to centre (7.27), scale ~1.00
structure.motion: settled; residual sway easings.inOutSine ~26 fr (suggested); no exit, film ends on the hold

params.brand: any brand.json: accent is the light (halo, rim, button gradient), bg near black, logo in the panel header
params.content.workspace: name shown in the panel header row with a chevron
params.content.tabs: two tab labels, the first selected
params.content.action: one-word label on the final button
params.glowColor: halo/rim colour, defaults to brand accent

notes: One continuous shot, 0 cuts in cuts.json, silent: every SFX is planned by the glue rule, not measured. Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s); all spring/easing names and frame counts are suggestions. The halo is the one light source: it moves from the glyph to the panel rim, dies, then is reborn on the button, so keep one accent colour. The button flip has no vocabulary id: proposed term edge-flip (see recipe.md). Catalogue hint prompt-typing was not seen on the sheets.
